name: icash_claim_agreement_delivery_recovery
source:
CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.icash_claim_agreement_delivery_recovery()
 RETURNS jsonb
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO ''
AS $function$
declare r icash_seller_agreement_private.delivery_recovery;email text;current_terms jsonb;
begin
 select j.* into r from icash_seller_agreement_private.delivery_recovery j
 join public.icash_accounts a on a.id=j.account_id and a.owner_user_id=j.requested_by and not a.bot_paused
 join public.icash_deal_files d on d.id=j.deal_id and d.account_id=j.account_id and d.stage='draft'
  and (d.terms-array['assignmentFeeCents','assignmentDepositCents'])=(j.expected_terms-array['assignmentFeeCents','assignmentDepositCents']) and d.terms->>'seller'=j.seller_name
 join public.icash_screening_jobs s on s.id=d.screening_id and s.account_id=j.account_id and s.state='complete'
 join auth.users u on u.id=j.requested_by and u.email is not null and u.email_confirmed_at is not null
 where (j.state='queued' or (
  j.state='needs_review' and j.result='{"sent":false,"status":"held"}'::jsonb
  and j.claimed_at<now()-interval '1 minute' and j.request_key like 'seller-confirmed:%'
  and exists(select 1 from public.icash_contract_text_deliveries x
   join public.icash_text_messages m on m.id=x.message_id and m.account_id=x.account_id and m.thread_id=x.thread_id
   join icash_seller_agreement_private.confirmations c on c.envelope_id=x.envelope_id and c.account_id=x.account_id and c.deal_id=j.deal_id
   where x.account_id=j.account_id and x.envelope_id=j.envelope_id and j.request_key='seller-confirmed:'||c.id::text
    and public.icash_confirmed_seller_contract_text_current(j.account_id,m.id)
    and not exists(select 1 from public.icash_operation_spend spend where spend.operation_key='text:'||m.id)
  ))) and j.expires_at>now() and public.icash_membership_work_allowed(j.account_id)
 and not exists(select 1 from public.icash_property_controls pc where pc.account_id=j.account_id and pc.property_id=s.snapshot->>'propertyId' and pc.manual)
 and exists(select 1 from public.icash_text_threads t where t.account_id=j.account_id and t.deal_id=j.deal_id and t.recipient=j.phone and t.party='seller'
  and t.retired_at is null and not t.paused and not t.manual_only and public.icash_sms_thread_review_current(j.account_id,t.id,true))
 and not exists(select 1 from public.icash_text_suppressions x where x.phone=j.phone)
 and not exists(select 1 from public.icash_contact_suppressions x where x.contact_key=encode(sha256(convert_to(j.phone,'UTF8')),'hex'))
 -- Automatic recovery retains the current offer-authority guards. A later
 -- withdrawal, changed property facts or revised quote invalidates old consent.
 and (j.request_key not like 'seller-confirmed:%' or not exists(
  select 1 from icash_call_offer_private.offers o where o.account_id=j.account_id and o.deal_id=j.deal_id
  and (o.snapshot is distinct from s.snapshot or coalesce(o.state->>'acceptedPriceCents','') !~ '^[1-9][0-9]*$'
   or o.state->'acceptedPriceCents' is distinct from d.terms->'priceCents' or o.state->'quotedPriceCents' is distinct from d.terms->'priceCents'
   or o.state->'factsPending'='true'::jsonb or o.state->'conditionPending'='true'::jsonb or o.state->'agreementRevisionRequired'='true'::jsonb
   or o.state->'contractBlocked'='true'::jsonb or o.state->'acceptanceConditional'='true'::jsonb or o.state->'payoffPending'='true'::jsonb)))
 order by j.created_at for update of j,d skip locked limit 1;
 if not found then return null;end if;
 select u.email into email from auth.users u where u.id=r.requested_by;
 select d.terms into current_terms from public.icash_deal_files d where d.id=r.deal_id and d.account_id=r.account_id;
 update icash_seller_agreement_private.delivery_recovery set state='claimed',claimed_at=now(),expected_terms=current_terms where id=r.id;
 return jsonb_build_object('id',r.id,'accountId',r.account_id,'userId',r.requested_by,'customerEmail',email,'dealId',r.deal_id,'phone',r.phone,'sellerName',r.seller_name,'expectedTerms',current_terms);
end $function$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.icash_ingest_text_event(p_event jsonb, p_optout boolean)
 RETURNS void
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 SET search_path TO ''
AS $function$
begin
 perform 1 from public.icash_operating_budget where id=1 for update;
 perform public.icash_ingest_text_event_before_operational(p_event,p_optout);
end $function$

name: icash_seller_agreement_call_context
source:
CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.icash_seller_agreement_call_context(p_hash text, p_conversation text)
 RETURNS jsonb
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 STABLE SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO ''
AS $function$
declare matches jsonb;
begin
 if coalesce(p_hash,'') !~ '^[a-f0-9]{64}$' or coalesce(p_conversation,'') !~ '^conv_[A-Za-z0-9]+$' then return null;end if;
 with calls as (
  select 'inbound:'||s.id::text call_key,s.account_id,b.deal_id,t.id thread_id,t.recipient phone
  from icash_recorded_reception_private.sessions s join icash_recorded_reception_private.configs c on c.id=s.config_id
  join icash_seller_agreement_private.inbound_bindings b on b.session_id=s.id and b.account_id=s.account_id
  join public.icash_text_threads t on t.id=b.thread_id and t.deal_id=b.deal_id and t.account_id=b.account_id and t.recipient=s.from_phone
  where s.stop_token_hash=p_hash and s.conversation_id=p_conversation and s.state='recording' and s.recording_authorized_at is not null and s.recording_sid is not null
   and s.end_requested_at is null and s.call_ended_at is null and s.call_deadline_at>now() and c.enabled and c.context_policy in ('seller_agreement_v3','seller_agreement_v4','automatic_offer_v5','automatic_offer_v6','automatic_offer_v7','automatic_offer_v8','automatic_offer_v9','automatic_offer_v10','automatic_offer_v11','automatic_offer_v12','automatic_offer_v13','automatic_offer_v14','automatic_offer_v15','automatic_offer_v16','automatic_offer_v17','automatic_offer_v18') and c.reviewed_until>now()
  union all
  select 'outbound:'||c.id::text,c.account_id,d.id,t.id,r.to_phone
  from public.icash_live_conversations c join public.icash_deal_files d on d.account_id=c.account_id and d.screening_id=c.screening_id
  join public.icash_call_recordings r on r.account_id=c.account_id and r.operation_key=c.operation_key
   and r.screening_id=c.screening_id and r.contact_key=c.contact_key and r.party='seller'
   and r.conversation_id=c.conversation_id and r.stop_token_hash=p_hash
   and r.call_ended_at is null and r.end_requested_at is null
  left join public.icash_text_threads t on t.account_id=c.account_id and t.deal_id=d.id and t.recipient=r.to_phone and t.retired_at is null
  where c.tool_token_hash=p_hash and c.conversation_id=p_conversation and c.tool_expires_at>now() and c.state='waiting' and c.party='seller'
 )
 select jsonb_agg(jsonb_build_object('callKey',c.call_key,'accountId',c.account_id,'ownerUserId',a.owner_user_id,'ownerEmail',u.email,'dealId',d.id,'screeningId',d.screening_id,'phone',c.phone)) into matches
 from calls c join public.icash_accounts a on a.id=c.account_id and not a.bot_paused
 join auth.users u on u.id=a.owner_user_id and u.email is not null and u.email_confirmed_at is not null
 join public.icash_deal_files d on d.id=c.deal_id and d.account_id=c.account_id
 join public.icash_screening_jobs sc on sc.id=d.screening_id and sc.account_id=d.account_id
 left join public.icash_text_threads t on t.id=c.thread_id and t.account_id=c.account_id and t.party='seller'
 where d.stage not in ('closed','cancelled') and coalesce(d.terms->>'practice','false')<>'true'
 and (c.thread_id is null or (t.id is not null and t.retired_at is null and not t.paused and not t.manual_only)) and public.icash_membership_work_allowed(c.account_id)
 and not exists(select 1 from public.icash_property_controls pc where pc.account_id=c.account_id and pc.property_id=sc.snapshot->>'propertyId' and pc.manual)
 and not exists(select 1 from public.icash_text_suppressions where phone=c.phone)
 and not exists(select 1 from public.icash_contact_suppressions where contact_key=encode(sha256(convert_to(c.phone,'UTF8')),'hex'));
 if coalesce(jsonb_array_length(matches),0)<>1 then return null;end if;
 return matches->0;
end $function$
